name: Afonja sacks Apomu and topples Awole

summary.text: Alaafin Awole, who had come to the throne by murdering his father Abiodun, quarrelled with his field marshal Afonja, whose war camp was at Ilorin. In 1793 Afonja refused to attack Iwere-Ile, Abiodun's mother's town, fearing an old curse. In 1795 Awole ordered him against Apomu, a market town of Ife, though every Alaafin swore never to attack Ife. Afonja obeyed, sacked Apomu, then turned his army on Oyo-Ile, which no Kakanfo might enter, and demanded that Awole abdicate. Awole took his own life, and the empire fell into twenty years without a settled king.

moments.title: Apomu sacked
moments.text: An Oyo army attacks a town of holy Ife.

moments.title: Awole's death
moments.text: Faced with Afonja's army, the Alaafin takes his own life.
